transformation: VPX player view: x = raw_x / 952, y = raw_y / 1974, rounded to six decimals. Wall points use the arithmetic mean of all drag points; reset-coil projections use the arithmetic mean of raw target centers. Bank and coil projections are not physical coil centers.

switch:17.notes: The seven placements are means of drag points from script-bound walls sw17a through sw17g, projections onto the scoring contact assemblies rather than measured contact centers.

switch:13.notes: The self-test table names public 13 lane #3 without assigning a side. This observed placement uses Trigger.sw15 at the right lane to follow the physical replacement reproduction in photo-026. That board and the table artwork label #1 left and #3 right, while the table pairs switch 13/lamp 24 left and switch 15/lamp 56 right. Original 1980 artwork orientation remains unverified; the self-test table supplies identity and Figure V corroborates relative order, but no absolute placement fit is claimed.

switch:15.notes: The self-test table names public 15 lane #1 without assigning a side. This observed placement uses Trigger.sw13 at the left lane to follow the physical replacement reproduction in photo-026. That board and the table artwork label #1 left and #3 right, while the table pairs switch 13/lamp 24 left and switch 15/lamp 56 right. Original 1980 artwork orientation remains unverified; the self-test table supplies identity and Figure V corroborates relative order, but no absolute placement fit is claimed.

lamp_bulb_audit.disposition: The 27 mesh-visible lights are gi-prefixed table lights. No controlled lamp light has show_bulb_mesh; this audit does not establish physical GI-string membership or total bulb quantities.

supplemental_vpw_audit.disposition: The 85 Light objects show no bulb meshes. The combined BM_Parts mesh was separated into 965 connected pieces; the largest three align in plan with top lane inserts and have flat 0.47 to 10.12 VPU z profiles, but this investigation did not establish a reliable physical socket identity and wiring map.

lane_orientation.basis: Physical replacement reproduction photographed as IMG_4432; original-era artwork orientation unverified
lane_orientation.manual_role: The self-test table assigns lane numbers without sides; Figure V draws rollover circles left-to-right 15, 14, 13 and corroborates relative order, but its differing geometry is not fitted to validate absolute placements/as-built artwork
lane_orientation.placement_decision: Retain observed crosswise outer-switch anchors; no lamp socket coordinates are adopted

unresolved_output_states.physical_fitment: The game's A3 and harness drawings mark these physical loads N/U
unresolved_output_states.published_state: A startup burst is observed across outputs 17-20 on all three retained ROM runs; its PIA-write or ROM-initialization cause remains unpinned
